_comment: Injection grammar for Vue directives (v-if, :prop, @click, #slot). The rules themselves already live in vue.tmLanguage.json's repository, but they are only reachable from the SFC root there -- a template BODY is delegated to text.html.derivative, which knows nothing about Vue. VS Code ships these same rules as a separate grammar contributed with injectTo; this is that grammar, pointed at the rules we already have.
